Map gene IDs or symbols to genome coordinates

Source: R/annotate-positions.R
annotate_positions.Rd

Look up genomic positions for a set of gene identifiers in a gene annotation. This is the inverse of annotate_genes(), which maps variant positions to the nearest gene; here you start from gene identifiers and get their coordinates, for example to feed into value_manhattan().

Usage

annotate_positions(ids, annotation, id_type = c("gene_id", "symbol"))

Arguments

ids

Character vector of gene identifiers (Ensembl gene IDs such as "ENSG00000141510", Entrez IDs, or gene symbols such as "TP53").

annotation

Gene models as a GenomicRanges::GRanges object, or a TxDb (GenomicFeatures) or EnsDb (ensembldb) object. Gene IDs are read from the gene_id metadata column (or names()), symbols from gene_name, symbol or gene. GTF and GFF3 files can be read with rtracklayer::import(); keep the type == "gene" rows.

id_type

Whether ids are gene IDs ("gene_id", default) or gene symbols ("symbol").

Value

A GenomicRanges::GRanges with one range per matched identifier and metadata columns id (the input identifier), gene (symbol) and gene_id. Identifiers that cannot be mapped are dropped.

See also

value_manhattan(), annotate_genes()

Examples

genes <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
  c("chr17:7661779-7687538:-", "chr17:43044295-43170245:-"),
  gene_id = c("ENSG00000141510", "ENSG00000012048"),
  gene_name = c("TP53", "BRCA1")
)
annotate_positions(c("ENSG00000141510", "ENSG00000012048"), genes)
#> Mapped 2/2 identifiers to coordinates.
#> GRanges object with 2 ranges and 3 metadata columns:
#>       seqnames            ranges strand |              id        gene
#>          <Rle>         <IRanges>  <Rle> |     <character> <character>
#>   [1]    chr17   7661779-7687538      - | ENSG00000141510        TP53
#>   [2]    chr17 43044295-43170245      - | ENSG00000012048       BRCA1
#>               gene_id
#>           <character>
#>   [1] ENSG00000141510
#>   [2] ENSG00000012048
#>   -------
#>   seqinfo: 1 sequence from an unspecified genome; no seqlengths
annotate_positions(c("TP53", "NOT_A_GENE"), genes, id_type = "symbol")
#> Mapped 1/2 identifiers to coordinates.
#> GRanges object with 1 range and 3 metadata columns:
#>       seqnames          ranges strand |          id        gene         gene_id
#>          <Rle>       <IRanges>  <Rle> | <character> <character>     <character>
#>   [1]    chr17 7661779-7687538      - |        TP53        TP53 ENSG00000141510
#>   -------
#>   seqinfo: 1 sequence from an unspecified genome; no seqlengths
